scenario_name: L. salivarius laboratory batch protein recovery
pH_model: full charge balance or measured buffer curve
purpose: Reference laboratory fermentation directly supported by green-crop paper
recommended_use: Primary biological protein-recovery subscenario after calibration of mu_max and K_s
validation_targets: pH 4.1-4.3 overnight; crop-specific CP recovery 12.1-23.4% of fresh-crop CP
warnings: Kinetic constants for BS1001 are missing; fit to pH-time data.

pH_model: charge balance with dynamic feed mixing
separation_route: decanter centrifuge to ~30% DM protein paste
validation_targets: 30-40 C; exit pH ~4.0; final trailer pH 3.8; 60-70 h continuous operation; 29% of fermented-juice CP captured
warnings: Demo yield included overflow and drying stoppage losses; do not treat as intrinsic biological maximum.

kinetic_model: Monod + Luedeking-Piret + viable-cell death + malolactic conversion
pH_model: full charge balance with lactate, acetate and malate speciation
purpose: Most mechanistic pH and acidification subscenario
data_completeness: high for equations; medium for transferable parameterization
recommended_use: Sensitivity analysis for buffer capacity, salt, death rate and stationary-phase acid production
validation_targets: pH decline to ~3.2; lactate continues after growth; up to 51% after growth without salt
warnings: Cucumber-juice parameters and NaCl conditions are not directly grass-juice values.

kinetic_model: published substrate limitation + substrate inhibition + linear lactate inhibition + Luedeking-Piret
pH_model: source data used constant pH 6.5; uncontrolled pH extension required
purpose: Published kinetic benchmark and code-verification case
recommended_use: Unit tests and solver verification, not primary grass-juice prediction
validation_targets: 20-100 g/L lactose batch curves; R2 >=0.998 in source model
warnings: Dairy lactose model is poorly transferable to grass sugars and uncontrolled pH.

scenario_name: L. paracasei green-juice lactic acid scenario
purpose: Alternative LAB scenario with reported green-juice nutrient compatibility
recommended_use: Screening scenario using 0.78-0.91 g lactate/g sugar yield
warnings: Full kinetic parameters and direct protein-recovery data are absent from supplied papers.

pH_model: two-stage: growth at controlled pH then optional acidification, or uncontrolled model after calibration
recommended_use: Lactic-acid production comparison, not yet a validated direct protein-precipitation scenario
validation_targets: 98.8 g/L L-lactic acid in 30 h at 52 C and pH 6.0
warnings: Published example used controlled pH 6.0, which prevents isoelectric precipitation during fermentation.

kinetic_model: multi-population Monod competition with homo/hetero pathway split
pH_model: full charge balance with lactate and acetate
recommended_use: Enable only after community composition or time-series data are obtained
validation_targets: Rapid pH decline with controlled acetate/CO2 formation
warnings: Strongly underdetermined; not recommended as base case.
